notes.title: Version 1.1
notes.notes:
This update went live a while ago, but I neglected to announce the changes. Just a couple of small fixes in this one:

 Added a fix for a rare graphics rendering bug which could cause the game to freeze at random moments.
 Fixed a bug which could cause the game to soft-lock during the poisoning scene.

notes.title: Version 1.0 (Early Access)
notes.notes:
Six new achievements! Guilty Witness, Voyeur, Expert Thief, Photographer, Sadist and Masochist.
The "suicide" and "unsolved" endings have been swapped around. (Basically the feeling was that the suicide ending is quite hard to achieve and was rather downbeat, whereas the unsolved ending is comparatively easy to reach and feels more positive. This way round seems to make more sense.)
Fixed a few typos in the dialogue.

Since The Deed series is fairly popular among Chinese speakers, we're currently working on a Chinese translation which we'd like to implement before we leave Early Access. This will delay the full release for a while longer.

If you've been waiting for the finished English-language version of the game before playing, version 1.0 should be fairly complete and final. I will continue to fix any bugs or issues that get reported.

notes.title: Version 0.6 (Early Access)
notes.notes:
This one took a little longer than I had planned, but it is the biggest update the game has had so far. If everything goes well, there will probably be just one more update before the game leaves Early Access. (Of course, I will continue to update the game after that if any further issues come up.)

 Implemented some basic animations for when the player is interacting with the environment or picking up objects.
 Added a few extra variable checks to hopefully fix the occasional issues with NPC movements, characters being duplicated or being in the wrong places at the wrong time.
 It should no longer be possible for the murder to remain "unsolved" if there was a witness to the crime. Either the player or the witness will always be found guilty.
 When accusing Aspasia of the crime, the inspector would sometimes fail to find evidence planted in Frank's car. This has been fixed.
 It is no longer possible to employ the "wait" function in the bathroom. Other characters might need to use the facilities!
 Fixed a couple of movement issues involving the player blocking Madame Dupont's path.
 Fixed an issue with Mistress Chevalier's portrait remaining on screen if you don't have enough francs to engage with her.
 Fixed some errors during the interview stage when the inspector asks about your conversation with Giovanni regarding Mistress Chevalier.
 Removed an unnecessary menu when you examine the nurse's outfit.
 Corrected a few typos in the dialogue.

Please let us know if you experience any issues with this update!

notes.title: Version 0.5 (Early Access)
notes.notes:
The size of the game installation has been reduced to around 420MB.
Fixed a bug where Frank's corpse would sometimes magically disappear if you shot him in the parlour.
Fixed a rare bug where Aspasia would be invisible when moving upstairs from the salon.
There is a new way to increase the suspicion of Frank having committed suicide.
Fixed a couple of errors during the interrogation when questions to Giovanni Santi about Mistress Chevalier, or questions about Giovanni to Atma, would be skipped or incorrectly described.
Sometimes the inspector would incorrectly state that certain items were missing from the safe, which has now been corrected.
A couple of small aesthetic tweaks and additions.

Please let us know if you experience any issues with this update!

notes.title: Version 0.3 (Early Access)
notes.notes:
Version 0.3 of the game is now live! This contains a few bug fixes.

    A problem with the Giovanni Santi ending has been resolved. You can now see the proper epilogue and earn "The Artist" achievement if you manage to frame him successfully.
    The "Bloodbath" achievement also wasn't unlocking at the appropriate time. All achievements should now be working correctly.
    One of the tiles in the staircase leading from the salon to the middle floor was impassable, which has now been fixed.
    Interacting with Marie Dupont while using the mouse was a bit tricky sometimes, so her hit box has been extended.
    During the interrogation, there was a bug which would sometimes cause the inspector to skip your conversation with Atma, which has now been fixed.

Please let us know if you experience any other issues! There is a special "Early Access" sub-forum in the community hub where you can report any problems.
